translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Dɑɑ te tɑ yɑrimɔ
sɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun di

Yen biru durɔ wi, u kɑ Esekiɛli gɔsirɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔwɔ. Yerɑ nim mu kurɑmɔ dii ten kɔnnɔn tem di sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ. Domi dii ten kɔnnɔ gɑ mɛɛrɑwɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ. Mɑ nim mɛ, mu kokumɔ mu dɔɔ sɑ̃ɑ yerun nɔm geu giɑ yɑ̃ku yerun sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru giɑ.
Mɑ u mɑɑ kɑ nùn dɑ kɔnnɔ, ge gɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm geu giɑ. Mɑ bɑ besirɑ bɑ dɑ tɔɔwɔ sere kɔnnɔwɔ ge gɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ. Mɑ Esekiɛli u wɑ nim mɛ, mu kokumɔwɑ nɔm geu giɑ.
Durɔ wi, u dɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ. N deemɑ u wɛ̃ɛ nɛni win nɔmɑɔ. Nge mɛ u dɔɔ, u yɑm mi yĩirɑ gɔm soonu nɔrɔbu (1.000). Mɑ u Esekiɛli tɔburɑsiɑ. Mɑ nim mɛ, mu nɑ sere win nɑɑ wĩinɔ.
Yen biru u mɑɑ gɔm soonu nɔrɔbu yĩirɑ. Mɑ u derɑ Esekiɛli u nim mɛ tɔburɑ. Mɑ nim mɛ, mu nɑ sere win dũu wĩinɔ. Mɑ u mɑɑ susi u yĩirɑ gɔm soonu nɔrɔbu. Mɑ mu nɑ sere win pɔrɑɔ.
Mɑ u mɑɑ yĩirɑ gɔm soonu nɔrɔbu mi n sɑ̃ɑ nim bwee bɑkɑru te Esekiɛli u ǹ kpɛ̃ u tɔburɑ. Domi nim mɛ, mu duku. Goo kun kpɛ̃ u mu tɔburɑ mɑ n kun mɔ kɑ kɛ̃ɛri.
Mɑ u Esekiɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, tɔnun bii, ɑ ye kpuro mɛɛrɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ? Mɑ u kɑ nùn wurɑmɑ dɑɑ ten bɔ̃ɔwɔ.
Ye u kɑ nùn turɑ mi, yerɑ u wɑ dɑ̃nu nu dɑbi dɑɑ ten goo gookɑɔ.
Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nim mɛ, mu koo kokuwɑ mu dɑ wɔɔ berɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑɔ kɑ wɔwɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Arɑbɑɔ kpɑ mu sere dɑ nim wɔ̃kuɔ. Mɛyɑ mu koo nim wɔ̃kun nim dɛɛrɑsiɑ.
Mi nim mɛ, mu gesi duɑ kpuro, hunde koni ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi yɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑru mɔwɑ. Kpɑ swɛ̃ɛ yi n dɑbi. Domi mi nim mɛ, mu duɑ kpuro mu koo mɛ mu tie dɛɛrɑsiɑwɑ.

Sɑɑ Engɛdin di n kɑ dɑ Eni Egɑlɑimuɔ, surɔkɔbɑ bɑ ko n dɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ mi, bɑ n yɑ̃ɑkoronu keewɑ dɑɑ ten goorɔ. Tɑ ko n swɛ̃ɛ bwese bwesekɑ mɔwɑ nge nim wɔ̃ku ge bɑ sokumɔ Mɛditerɑnɛ. Swɛ̃ɛ yi, yi ko n dɑbi.
Adɑmɑ bɑ koo ten dɑɑ burenu kɑ ten yɛrusu deriwɑ bɔɔ te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ min sɔ̃.

Ten goonɔ dɑ̃ɑ ko n kpiɑwɑ nìn wurusu kun dɛrurɑmɔ, nìn mɑrum kun mɑɑ kpeemɔ. Nu ko n dɑ yewɑ suru bɑɑwure. Domi nu ko n nim wɑɑmɔwɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun di. Bɑ ko n dɑ dɑ̃ɑ nin mɑrum diwɑ kpɑ bu kɑ nin wurusu bɑrɑrun tim ko.
Yinni Gusunɔ u Isirelibɑn
tem nɔɔ burɑ yenu yiimɔ
Amɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ geruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, tem mɛ i ko i bɔnu ko, kon bɛɛ mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yenu sɔ̃ɔsi. Yosɛfun bwese kɛrɑ bɔnu yiruwɑ yɑ koo wɑ.
Bwese kɛri yi yi tien bɔnu yɑ ko n nɛwɑ. Domi nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɔmɑ suɑ nɑ bɔ̃ruɑ nɑ nɛɛ, bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑrɑ kon mu wɛ̃. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɛɛ i ko i mu wɑ i tubi di.
Tem mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru wee. Sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm geu giɑ, tɑ toruɑ sɑɑ nim wɔ̃ku ge bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛn di n kɑ dɑ Hɛtilonin swɑɑɔ sere kɑ Sedɑdin wuu duu yerɔ,
kɑ Hɑmɑtiɔ kɑ Bɛrɔtɑɔ kɑ Siburɑimuɔ. N deemɑ wuu si, su wɑ̃ɑwɑ Dɑmɑsi kɑ Hɑmɑtin nɔɔ burɑ yerun bɑɑ sɔɔ kɑ Hɑsɛɛ Hɑtikonin temɔ Hɑfɑrɑnin tem nɔɔ burɑ yeru giɑ.
Nge mɛyɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm geun tem nɔɔ burɑ yee te, tɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ sɑɑ nim wɔ̃ku ge bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛn di n kɑ girɑri Hɑsɑɑ Enɔɔwɔ Dɑmɑsin tem nɔɔ burɑ yerɔ kɑ Sɑfoniɔ Hɑmɑtin tem nɔɔ burɑ yerɔ.

Sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ mɑɑ tem mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ koo dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛni swĩiwɑ Hɑfɑrɑniɔ kɑ Dɑmɑsiɔ kɑ Gɑlɑdiɔ kɑ Isirelibɑn tem bɑɑ sɔɔ. Tɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sɑɑ tem nɔɔ burɑ yee te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm geu giɑn di n kɑ nɑ nim wɔ̃ku bɔruguuɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ.

Sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru giɑn tem nɔɔ burɑ yee te, tɑ koo dɑwɑ sɑɑ Tɑmɑɑn di sere kɑ Mɛribɑn bwiɑɔ Kɑdɛsiɔ kpɑ tu Egibitin dɑɑru swĩi sere n kɑ girɑri nim wɔ̃ku ge bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛɔ. Nɔɔ burɑ yee te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru giɑ, terɑ mi.
Sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru giɑn tem nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nim wɔ̃ku ge bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛ mɑ yɑ yɔ̃rɑ Hɑmɑtin deedeeru sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm geu giɑ. Sɔ̃ɔ duu yerugiɑrɑ mɑɑ mi.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri wɔkurɑ yiru sɔɔ
i ko i tem mɛ bɔnu ko kɑ tɛtɛ bɛɛn tii tiinɛ sɔɔ kɑ sɔɔ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛɛ bɑ kɑ bibu mɑrɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ. I ko i bu gɑrisiwɑ nge Isirelibɑ. Kpɑ i tubi ye bɔnu ko kɑ be sɑnnu kɑ tɛtɛ.
I ko i sɔɔ nùn win bɑɑ wɛ̃wɑ bwese kɛrɑ yè sɔɔ u wɑ̃ɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni geruɑ.
